description: This file defines classes and methods for managing bank statements, statement lines, and reconciliation in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including calculations of balances, currency handling, and confirmation/cancellation workflows.

classes.name: account_bank_statement
classes.description: Model for managing bank statements, including default values, balance calculations, confirmation, cancellation, and currency handling.

classes.name: account_bank_statement_reconcile
classes.description: Model for reconciling bank statement entries with account moves.

classes.name: account_bank_statement_reconcile_line
classes.description: Model for individual reconciliation lines within a statement reconciliation.

classes.name: account_bank_statement_line
classes.description: Model for individual bank statement lines, including partner association, amount, and reconciliation.

methods.name: _default_journal_id
methods.description: Returns default journal ID from context if available.

methods.name: _default_balance_start
methods.description: Fetches the starting balance for a new statement based on the latest statement for the journal.

methods.name: _end_balance
methods.description: Calculates the ending balance of a statement considering move lines and statement lines.

methods.name: _currency
methods.description: Determines the currency for a statement, defaulting to journal or company currency.

methods.name: button_confirm
methods.description: Confirms the statement, creating account moves and reconciling entries.

methods.name: button_cancel
methods.description: Cancels a confirmed statement, deleting associated moves.

methods.name: onchange_journal_id
methods.description: Updates starting balance and currency when journal is changed.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Deletes draft statements; prevents deletion of confirmed ones.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Duplicates a statement, resetting move lines.
